tasks.label: Set Up venv and Install Requirements
tasks.detail: Build .venv from Homebrew's python@3.14, then install requirements-dev.txt. Re-run it after editing requirements

tasks.label: Build all objects
tasks.detail: Regenerate tracked STL and PNG files from every object source

tasks.label: Build current object
tasks.detail: Regenerate tracked STL and PNG files for the active OpenSCAD source

tasks.label: Clean .scadbak backups
tasks.detail: Delete every scadformat backup file under the workspace
tasks.command: find '${workspaceFolder}' -type f -name '*.scadbak' -print -delete | wc -l | xargs -I{} echo 'removed {} .scadbak file(s)'

tasks.label: Clean Bambu Studio projects
tasks.detail: Delete every ignored .3mf slicer project under the workspace
tasks.command: find '${workspaceFolder}' -type f -name '*.3mf' -print -delete | wc -l | xargs -I{} echo 'removed {} .3mf file(s)'
